summary_en: 300,000 shares (2.20% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired on the Tokyo Stock Exchange at an upper limit of ¥1,000,000,000 from August 3, 2026 to March 31, 2027 via open-market purchases. Stated rationale: shareholder returns and capital efficiency improvement.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock Pursuant to Articles of Incorporation Under the Provisions of Article 165(2) of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: On July 31, 2026, the board of Ishihara Chemical resolved to initiate a share buyback under Article 156 of the Companies Act (as applied by Article 165(3)). The program targets up to 300,000 ordinary shares (2.20% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) at an aggregate cost not to exceed ¥1,000,000,000. Purchases will be executed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange via open-market buys between August 3, 2026 and March 31, 2027. The stated purpose is to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency while enabling flexible capital management in response to changing business conditions. As of June 30, 2026, 13,665,504 shares were outstanding (excluding treasury), and the company held 1,488,176 treasury shares.
